plain: Blame or criticism for a fault; also to blame someone

webster.text: To censure in terms of opprobrium or contempt.

more.text: To charge with a fault in severe language.
To upbraid; to suggest blame for any thing.
To treat with scorn or contempt.
Object of contempt, scorn or derision.
That which is the cause of shame or disgrace.
